report.explanation: Gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0012, p95 80ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. A single ERROR trace shows gateway->order call at 1999ms, but no order-side telemetry is available to establish downstream latency or any other bounded cause. Insufficient evidence for a root-cause candidate; hand off for order/downstream telemetry.
missing_evidence: Order service traces/metrics/logs for the same window to confirm or refute downstream latency
Order-side dependency timings (inventory, payment, postgresql) to localize the 1999ms call
Error-rate and latency time series beyond the single aggregated gateway sample
Confirmation whether the single ERROR trace is representative or an isolated outlier
